calibration: raw and temperature for every model, including ResNet; positive scalar per expert fitted only on calibration, clean/jpeg70/resize05; local variance divided by T squared

clip.head: StandardScaler then LogisticRegression(C=1, liblinear, max_iter=2000, random_state=20261018)
clip.local: four mean-pooled normalized features from 56px PatchShuffle views; seeds 202610220..202610223
clip.precision: FP16 encoder on CUDA as Round 6; embeddings normalized in FP32

expert_training: expert_fit originals, clean only; no development/test inputs
fusion: global/local/average/fixed/score_gate/quality_gate; logits fused. Fixed alpha grid 0..1 by .1, max selection SD15 macro AUROC over tuning conditions; ties nearest .5 then smaller.

gates.fitting: gate_fit only; minimum pooled selection BCE over clean/jpeg70/resize05, epoch0 eligible

metrics.ci: 95% percentile, class-stratified original-image draws; identical draws paired across models, initializations and conditions. Gate summary averages metrics/replicates across three initializations, not logits.
metrics.limitations: Selection estimates are optimistic after fitting thresholds/epochs/gates; bootstrap conditions on fitted models and chosen settings; no multiplicity correction. ADM/BigGAN development is previously inspected-domain evidence.
metrics.macro: Equal mean over all four conditions; separate SD15 selection, ADM development, BigGAN development; shared real images counted once per pooled dataset

outputs: results/round7/baselines_seed1 and artifacts/round7/baselines_seed1 only; exclusive-create outputs, validated read-only resume caches

resnet.checkpoint: Initialization plus every completed epoch; model, optimizer, scheduler, Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG and history; exclusive filenames; resume latest valid checkpoint
resnet.epoch_selection: Maximum mean selection AUROC over clean/jpeg70/resize05; exact tie retains earliest epoch
resnet.normalization: ImageNet mean/std after identical RGB geometry/degradation; CLIP uses CLIP mean/std
resnet.oom_policy: Only CUDA OOM permits batch reduction (halving); rollback whole failed epoch to prior checkpoint, restore RNG/optimizer/scheduler and retry. Record batch changes. Never silently reduce for another reason.
resnet.schedule: CosineAnnealingLR T_max=10 eta_min=0; step once after each epoch

test_isolation: Read only ID-only Step B denylist, never reserved_test_manifest.jsonl. Assert allowlist/denylist before decode, feature use, fitting and predictions. GLIDE/VQDM/Midjourney/Wukong are forbidden before final evaluation.
threshold: Per model/profile/calibration/initialization, pooled selection Youden J over clean/jpeg70/resize05; ties closest probability threshold .5 (Round 6); fixed across all four reporting conditions
